kicker: WORDS — A LEXICON OF THE ATLAS
title:
THE
WORDS
dek: Russian words that carry the argument of the atlas, written as they are written in Russian, with transliteration and the plates where each is examined. The English edition uses the transliteration in running text; this page is its key.
note1: Register is the kind of speech a word belongs to: liturgical, everyday, scholarly, regional. A word used in one register in one source is not thereby used in another.
note2: The list is not a dictionary of Russian death. It contains only words the atlas uses, and where the atlas calls a category a scholarly construction (*zalozhnye*, *rusalka*) the entry says so.
